spans.text: Dragons in Somnus Domina are as fearsome as in any other realm. They are some of the only creatures that survived from the Old World, though they lost most of (if not all, according to some) of their gods in the transition. Dragons mostly stepped back during the early years of the First Age, allowing the world to heal. Many took this time to build homes and kingdoms, but were warned alongside other great beasts of the realms that they should allow the world to find its feet or suffer the Eidolons’ wrath. In this age they mostly keep themselves hidden and operate from behind the scenes.

Particularly ancient dragons have a bargaining chip that younger ones do not - knowledge of the previous ages. Knowing where the world’s power comes from and the nature of groups like the Eidolons gives them protection against their wrath, as there is a persistent understanding that if they do not interfere with history’s course then they will not be interfered with. Dragons born in the late First Age and forward do not have this benefit, however, and act as the dragons of old might have.
